principles: one canonical generator request per domain
GENERATE is deterministic and never mutates seed
REROLL is the only ordinary seed mutation path
class and size are realized by topology and certified module families before geometry correction
whole-assembly scale correction is limited to 0.85..1.15
generated module instances may not exceed 1.50 absolute scale
invalid generation fails closed and never replaces the last known-good assembly
all class certification uses transformed three-dimensional bounds
Systems and PCG are clients/inspectors of the same generation request rather than competing generators
Blender is a parity client of the same request contract
station radial/vertical kitbash assembly is compatibility exterior preview only until interior/service-program generation replaces it
currentShipPipeline: fail-closed promotion of certified candidate only
